// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/profile-writes-single-path.test.ts.
// The compliant shape: read the row, decide through applyFactWrites, persist
// what it decided (and only that). The guard must pass this.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { applyFactWrites, existingFacts, factWritesFrom, profileFactData } from "@/lib/services/protection-profile/fact-writes"

export async function probeSinglePath(userId: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const existing = await db.policyholderProfile.findUnique({ where: { userId } })
    const facts = profileFactData(
        applyFactWrites({
            existing: existingFacts(existing as Record<string, unknown> | null),
            writes: factWritesFrom(patch, { source: "questionnaire", precision: "exact" }),
            now: new Date(),
        })
    )
    await db.policyholderProfile.upsert({
        where: { userId },
        update: { ...facts },
        create: { userId, ...facts },
    })
}
